Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Antigen Retrieval System:- SPECIFICATIONS: 1) Slide Capacity 48 Glass slides (2 tanks of 24 slides with racks) Reagent Capacity 1.5L 2) Operating Temperature 41°-104°F (5°-40°C) 3) Voltage 100/120VAC 50/60Hz, 220/240VAC 50/60Hz Amperage 10A max 120VAC, 5A max 4) Should be based upon water bath technique that unifies 12 different protocols into a single 240VAC prot ocol for epitope retrieval. 5) Easy to use, one-touch operation via built-in touch screen 6) Ability to modify the start/ stop time and temperature settings to optimize results 7) Should be able to perform De-waxing and antigen retrieval simultaneously without changing the reagen t/solution 8) Should have at least two separate chambers to allow the use of High and Low pH buffers simultaneousl y, volume at least 1litre in each chamber. 9) Operator defined, preprogrammed time and temperature settings 10) Dual reaction baths, each with 24-slide capacity, for simultaneous operation of two independent proce dures 11) Proprietary epitope recovery solutions for safe, nontoxic, solvent-free and environmentally improved d ewaxing 12) Provides for rapid, gentle heating, eliminating microwave and pressure cooker variability 13) Maintains excellent tissue/ cellular morphology 14) Efficient, time-saving transfer of fully compatible slide racks directly to any Autostainer after treatment to avoid slide manipulation 15) Should be equipped with delay start option for setting up the timer that will be programmed to autom atically start the process at the desired time without human intervention. 16) Should allow antigen retrieval buffer reuse up-to at least 3-times without compromising desired staini ng quality. 17) Should be fully automated walk away system having facility of storing run-to-run Log-Files for QC purp ose 18) Should have US-FDA and European CE approval for IVD use 19) 5 years warranty and 5years CMC to be provided by the 0EM or the authorized dealer
